libs.description: Shared libraries most modern mods (and the standard set's content mods) declare as dependencies.

MagicLib.name: MagicLib
MagicLib.notes: Nexerelin needs MagicLib present to reach new-game sector generation; a missing MagicLib produced the ~150-mod-pack RingBand non-finite save crash class observed 2026-09-11.

era-0.8.1a.description: Historical 0.8.1a reference set for the untouched FlowerGod and Flu-X originals. Neither original declares an external dependency.

era-0.7.2a.description: Historical 0.7.2a Exigency reference set. Exact compatible library builds must be supplied and verified locally.

era-0.97a-RC11.description: Historical 0.97a-RC11 Omega Trauma reference set. Exact dependency builds remain evidence-gated.

era-0.65.2a.description: Historical 0.65.2a reference set for the untouched SEEKER original, which declares no external dependency.

era-0.62a.description: Historical 0.62a Vacuum reference set. Vacuum bundles its own LazyLib and shader JARs, so they are not installed as external mods.

standard.description: The standard compatibility pack (roadmap P4): libs plus AI Tweaks, Nexerelin and a handful of widely used content mods, verified present in the owner's real Starsector install at RC8 or a compatible 0.98a.

aitweaks.name: AI Tweaks
aitweaks.notes: SK-13 repro target: a SEEKER NPE via Person.getPersonality() returning null in CombatFleetManager.deployAll only appears with AI Tweaks enabled alongside SEEKER.

nexerelin.name: Nexerelin
nexerelin.notes: Depends on MagicLib to reach new-game sector generation; missing MagicLib was implicated in the 2026-09-11 RingBand non-finite save crash inside a ~150-mod pack.

swp.name: Ship/Weapon Pack
swp.notes: Widely used content mod; depends on LazyLib and GraphicsLib (shaderLib).

IndEvo.name: Industrial.Evolution
IndEvo.notes: Widely used campaign-content mod; depends on LazyLib, MagicLib, LunaLib and GraphicsLib (shaderLib).

US.name: Unknown Skies
US.notes: Widely used procgen/planet-content mod; depends on LunaLib and MagicLib.

tahlan.name: Tahlan Shipworks
tahlan.notes: Widely used ship-pack content mod; depends on LazyLib and MagicLib.
